reviewNotes: Directory research 2026-10-04: Google calls it 'Great Neck Ballroom Dance Studio'. Instagram handle is inconsistent: the site's icon links instagram.com/gn.ballroom, the contact text says 'IG: gnballroom' and a flyer shows @greatneckballroom; we used the linked one (could not open Instagram to check). The site's images are flyers, an AI-made banner and stock art, so no photos recorded. A rentals flyer on the home page advertises the studio for private parties (bar options, sound system, dance floor).
